Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Lee, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. LEE:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. LEE:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (stands up and starts pacing around the room) You don't understand me! You don't know what it's like to be me! 🌪️

DR. LEE:
(frustrated) Jack, stop this. You're not listening to me 🗣️.

JACK:
(outraged) I'm listening! I'm listening to the voices in my head! And they're telling me to make you take the pills! 💬

DR. LEE:
(skeptical) What are you talking about, Jack? You're not making any sense 🤔.

JACK:
(eyes flashing) I'm telling you, doc! You're the one who's crazy! You're the one who needs the pills! 💥

Dr. Lee's expression changes, and for a moment, he looks uncertain 🤔. Then, with a sense of resignation, he reaches for the pills on his desk and hands them to Jack 📦.

JACK:
(taking the pills and swallowing them) There, happy now? 🤪

Dr. Lee watches as Jack sits back down on the bed, a look of calm washes over his face, and he closes his eyes 👀.

DR. LEE:
(opening his eyes, but instead of seeing Jack, he sees a figure standing in front of him - a figure that looks exactly like Jack, but with a sinister grin on his face 😈)

JACK:
(in a voice that's not quite his own) You see, doc? I'm not just a patient. I'm the one who's been playing you all along. You're the one who's been medicated, not me 🤯.

Dr. Lee's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth - he's been living in a world of his own creation, and Jack is just a figment of his imagination 🌐.

DR. LEE:
(stunned) No... it can't be... I'm the one who's been sick all along... 🤯

The camera zooms out as Dr. Lee's world begins to unravel, and the sound of maniacal laughter echoes through the asylum 🎃.

FADE TO BLACK 🌑
